description: Land Settlement Department - Serana, Rideemaliyadda D/S Division, Badulla District - Cad. Map No. 710025
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration and determinations regarding specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with their ownership status, extents, and encumbrances, making it primarily about land and property matters. The content falls under the Land Gazette category as it involves land title settlement, property registration, and determinations of land ownership by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement.
